rv.q: Kat Evans as Maggie Carlin and Orion Lay-Sleeper as her comedic partner Eddie Gilroy are both absolutely terrific.

cn.t: Critics praise "Changing Channels" for its engaging blend of comedy and drama set against the Red Scare backdrop, with standout performances and witty writing that draws timely parallels to contemporary society.
